title: Predict 2 offers no way to reorder the kept cards ('put the rest back in any order')
expected: predict.ts:35-45 builds Predict N as an optional reveal-and-pick with onPicked:"recycle" and a chained `then: {type:"predict", amount: remaining}` only; no reorder step exists. pending-choice.ts:1462-1480 handles the decline (accept===false): it clears draft.pendingChoice and returns without executing choice.then and without moving/reordering the revealed cards, so declining the first prompt ends the Predict with the cards in original order. No reorder move exists anywhere in game-definition/, server.ts, or the gameplay UI (grep for reorder/orderTop finds nothing; keyword-effects.ts:126 only describes "reorder rest" in text). Card text (dramatic-visionary.ts:14) says "put the rest back in any order".
observed: Predict is implemented as sequential optional reveal-and-pick(recycle) prompts; choosing 'No' on the first prompt immediately ends the Predict with pendingChoice=null and the two cards left in their original order (Flame Chompers, Dangerous Duo) — no reorder prompt/move is ever offered. predict.ts comment confirms: 'recycle the pick, leave the rest on top … declining ends the Predict'.

history.note: Needs a missing engine capability: no reorder prompt/move exists (no PendingChoice kind, no move, no UI) for 'put the rest back in any order'; Predict is a chain of reveal-and-pick recycles. Requires a new pendingChoice kind + move + app UI, out of scope for a targeted fix.
